methods.evidence_sentence: We perform extensive experiments on the TVR, Charades-STA, and TACoS benchmark datasets, demonstrating that our model achieves state-of-the-art results on all three. # Abstract The goal of natural language video moment localization is to locate a short segment of a long, untrimmed video that corresponds to a description presented as natural text.
